mechanisms.entry_sequence: detect lag, wait for next completed premium acceleration confirmation, enter next observable bar
mechanisms.exit_logic: event-resolution exit on premium acceleration failure or max hold
mechanisms.expected_failure_mode: lag is noise or decays after costs
mechanisms.name: delayed_option_convexity_after_underlying_confirmation
mechanisms.rationale: Option premium may lag underlying continuation and expand only after a confirmation sequence, which static next-detection entries did not cover.
mechanisms.side: CE for up continuation, PE for down continuation

mechanisms.entry_sequence: compression regime then expansion confirmation, enter next observable bar
mechanisms.exit_logic: volatility-state resolution exit, not fixed point target only
mechanisms.expiry_dte_scope: exclude final expiry hour unless tested separately
mechanisms.name: premium_compression_release_with_underlying_state_filter
mechanisms.rationale: Compression followed by expansion is a path transition, not a static premium band or velocity snapshot.
mechanisms.side: CE or PE based on underlying expansion direction

mechanisms.exit_logic: resolution failure or fixed max hold
mechanisms.expected_failure_mode: requires cleaner chain synchronization than available
mechanisms.name: paired_ce_pe_divergence_resolution
pre_entry_observables: paired CE and PE premium response at same timestamp
mechanisms.rationale: Directionally similar underlying states may differ when CE and PE premium paths disagree; prior campaign did not build paired side features.
mechanisms.strike_rule: matched distance from spot on CE and PE

mechanisms.entry_sequence: multi-strike confirmation, enter selected liquid strike next bar
mechanisms.name: multi_strike_confirmation_of_premium_elasticity
mechanisms.rationale: A single contract can be noisy; coordinated response across adjacent strikes may identify real option demand or convexity.
mechanisms.side: CE for upside elasticity, PE for downside elasticity
